extracted.intended_audience: licensed small business investment companies (SBICs) and their accountants preparing SBA Form 468 financial reports
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and required line-item presentation for preparing the Financial Report (SBA Form 468) for licensed small business investment companies, including what to report, how to value items, filing timing, and supporting schedules and footnotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition of gain on sale of assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Gain on the sale of assets when the sale represents a final transaction may be recognized as realized gain immediately when received by a Licensee in cash (money, checks, or negotiable money orders), demand certificates of deposit issued by banks which are members of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, and/or negotiable direct obligations of the U.S. Government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only when proceeds are received in the specified cash or cash-equivalent forms may gain be recognized immediately as realized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary statement for sales to SBA (triplicate)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Licensee should submit to SBA, in triplicate, a summary statement identifying each sale transaction involved, giving the following particulars: a. portfolio securities, acquired (or successor) assets, or other assets parted with and their cost less allowance for losses, proceeds obtained, and net gain or loss; b. name of purchaser and affiliation (if any) with Licensee; c. description and value of consideration received, including terms and collateral (if any) of any debt instruments; and d. provisions of any rights or privileges obtained or granted by the Licensee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit three copies; include all four particulars (a–d) for each sale transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Income from operations classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions on the classification of income as realized and procedures to be followed when such amounts are not to be considered as realized are found in the notes to income accounts Nos. 500, 512, 516, 532 in the System of Account Classifications for Small Business Investment Companies (Part III of the regulations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the referenced notes to income accounts for classification rules and procedures when determining realized income from operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of gains not qualifying as realized
rubrics_metrics.description: Any profit on the sale of assets which does not qualify as realized gain in accordance with section 2.b. of this addendum should be credited to account No. 383, Other Deferred Credits, pending such realization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-realized profit must be parked in account No. 383 until qualification for realization is met per section 2.b.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBA recognition of noncash gain does not permit transfer from account No. 383
rubrics_metrics.description: SBA recognition of noncash gain on sales of assets shall not constitute approval to transfer the amount involved from account No. 383 to the appropriate gain accounts, as such action shall remain dependent on meeting the qualifications in section 2.b. of this addendum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if SBA recognizes a noncash gain, formal qualification per section 2.b is required before moving amounts out of account 383.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to file Financial Report (Form 468)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Financial Report, SBA Form 468, is required by Small Business Administration regulations to be filed with SBA by each licensed small business investment company at the end of the first 6-month period of each fiscal year and at the end of each fiscal year (SBA fiscal year = April 1 through March 31), and at such other times as SBA may request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports must present fairly the financial position as of the close of the period and the results of operations and be prepared in accordance with these instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing format and timing (triplicate; unaudited vs audited)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Financial Report shall be filed in triplicate with the Investment Division, Small Business Administration, on or before the last day of the month immediately following the close of the period covered by the report (unaudited), and on or before the last day of the third month following the close of the period covered by the report (audited).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe different deadlines depending on whether report is audited or unaudited; file three copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered investment companies must follow SEC rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Licensees which are registered investment companies should refer to rules promulgated by the Securities and Exchange Commission for the official requirements as to financial reports to be filed with SEC and the time allowed for filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a Licensee is an SEC-registered investment company, reconcile SBA instructions with SEC requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required components of Form 468
rubrics_metrics.description: The Financial Report, SBA Form 468, requires a statement of financial condition, statement of surplus reconciliations, statement of income and expense, statement of realized gain or loss on investments, and supporting schedules 1 through 14. If any statement or schedule is not applicable, it is still required to be filed but should be marked 'N/A' or 'Not Applicable.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include all listed statements and schedules; mark N/A where not applicable rather than omitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidation for wholly owned subsidiaries (management consulting)
rubrics_metrics.description: When the Licensee has a wholly owned subsidiary organized solely for the purpose of rendering management consulting services, financial reports submitted to SBA by the parent Licensee shall reflect consolidated figures covering the activities of both the parent Licensee and its subsidiary corporation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidate parent and the specified subsidiary for reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combine branch office figures
rubrics_metrics.description: When the Licensee has one or more branch offices, the data contained in the basic financial statements and all supporting schedules shall comprise a combination of the figures for the principal office and all branches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate principal and branch figures in statements and schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Express money amounts in whole dollars
rubrics_metrics.description: All money amounts required to be shown in the financial statements and schedules shall be expressed in whole dollars. Appropriate adjustments of individual amounts shall be made for the fractional part of a dollar so that the items will add to the totals shown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Round and adjust line items so totals reconcile; use whole dollars only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heading information and Employer Identification Number (EIN)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set forth in the appropriate spaces the information called for representing the identification and the principal office address of the Licensee. As the employer identification number, enter the number assigned to the Licensee by the U.S. Treasury Department. If such number has not yet been assigned, an Application for Employer Identification Number, Form SS-4, shall be submitted to the U.S. Director of Internal Revenue with whom the Licensee's Federal tax and employee withholding returns are filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full identification and office address; include EIN or evidence of SS-4 submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — Cash (Item 1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cash: State the total of all demand deposits, cash items in process of collection, and the petty cash fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include all demand deposits and cash items in transit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — U.S. Government obligations, insured savings, and time deposits (Item 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the sum of (1) total investment at cost in direct obligations of the U.S. Government and those obligations guaranteed as to principal and interest by the U.S. Government (increase in redemption value of U.S. Savings Bonds purchased at less than face value may be added to the original cost for this purpose), (2) total funds invested in insured savings accounts in institutions insured by the Federal Savings and Loan Insurance Corporation, and (3) total funds on time deposit with commercial banks which are members of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, evidenced by Time Certificates of Deposit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include purchase-price adjustments for certain savings bonds and only insured accounts/deposits as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — Notes receivable (Item 3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the current portion of the unpaid principal amount of miscellaneous notes receivable, including notes representing amounts due from debtors on sale of assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report only the current portion in this item; include notes from liquidation sales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — Accounts receivable (Item 4)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the combined total of all amounts due representing (1) advisory, consulting, appraisal, and miscellaneous services rendered, (2) declared dividends on capital stock of small business concerns, (3) sharings in the income of small business concerns, (4) amounts due on open account from debtors on sale of assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities, (5) 'participating' companies' portions of principal and accrued interest receivable from financed small business concerns, (6) miscellaneous current receivables, (7) accrued compensation receivable for services rendered to 'participating' companies, and (8) accrued commitment fees receivable for making funds available on a deferred basis; Less: Allowance for uncollectibles applicable to items 3 and 4—state amount of valuation reserve provided for estimated losses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out components as listed and show allowance for uncollectibles separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — Accrued interest receivable (Item 5)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of interest accrued on loans to and debt securities of small business concerns, U.S. Government obligations (direct and fully guaranteed), notes receivable, sales contracts, and other interest-bearing amounts due from debtors, including funds placed in escrow pending the closing of financing. Less: Allowance for uncollectibles—state amount of valuation reserve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include escrow interest accruals and present allowance for doubtful interest receivables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — Due from directors, officers, and employees (Item 6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the unpaid balance of amounts advanced to directors, officers, and employees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report advances to insiders separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — Funds in escrow and other current assets (Item 7)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the combined total of (1) funds in escrow pending the closing of financing for small business concerns, (2) the current portion of prepaid expenses and deferred charges, and (3) any miscellaneous current assets not provided for elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate escrow, prepaid, and other current assets in this line.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — Total Short-Term Assets (Item 8)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the total of the appropriate amounts opposite items 1, 2, 4(a), 5(a), 6, and 7.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum specified items to compute total short-term assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Financial Condition — Loans (section 305) (Item 9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the reporting company's portion of the unpaid principal balance of loans made to small business concerns pursuant to section 305 of the Small Business Investment Act of 1958, as amended. Obligations acquired which carry rights to conversion or stock purchase are obtained only under section 304 and are not to be included in this item but in item 10.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include only section 305 loans; exclude section 304 acquisitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loans — Less: amount sold with recourse (Item 9(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the reporting company's portion of the unpaid principal balance of loans outstanding to small business concerns which have been sold with recourse upon the company in the event of default.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report recourse-sold amounts separately as a deduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loans — Less: allowance for uncollectibles (Item 9(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: State the amount of the valuation reserve provided for estimated losses on the reporting company's portion of loans (section 305).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a valuation reserve line for loans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loans — Less: unearned discount, fees, etc. (Item 9(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the reporting company's portion of the total of unearned discount, fees, and other charges included in the unpaid principal balance of loans (section 305).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deductions for unearned items must be shown to arrive at net loan principal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debt securities of SBCs (section 304) (Item 10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the unpaid principal balance of the reporting company's portion of small business concerns' debt securities, convertible, and with attached stock purchase warrants or options, and debt securities divested of stock rights, all acquired by the company pursuant to section 304.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include section 304 debt securities; treat convertible and warrant-attached instruments as described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debt securities — Less: amount sold with recourse; allowance for losses; unearned discounts (Items 10(a)-(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Show deductions for portions sold with recourse, valuation reserves for estimated losses on debt securities, and unearned discount/fee charges included in unpaid principal balance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present each deduction separately to reach net debt securities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital stock of SBCs (section 304) (Item 11)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the value at cost of the reporting company's portion of small business concerns' convertible capital stock, capital stock with stock purchase warrants or options, and capital stock (without conversion privilege, stock purchase rights), all acquired pursuant to section 304. Less: allowance for losses—state amount of valuation reserve provided for estimated losses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report cost basis of section 304 equity holdings and provide loss allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warrants, options, and other stock rights acquired from SBCs (section 304) (Item 12)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the value at purchase price or at cost as otherwise determined of the reporting company's portion of warrants, options, and other stock rights acquired by the company from small business concerns pursuant to section 304. Less: allowance for losses—state valuation reserve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report cost or purchase price and show allowance for losses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities (Item 13)
rubrics_metrics.description: State, as recorded in the books of account, the reporting company's investment in assets acquired by foreclosure, or otherwise, in liquidation of loans (section 305) and debt securities (section 304), including judgments and sheriffs' certificates. Less: accumulated depreciation; less: mortgages payable; less: allowance for losses—state amounts for each deduction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show gross recorded investment and then list depreciation, mortgage encumbrances, and loss allowances separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Loans and Investments (Item 14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the total of the appropriate amounts opposite items 9(c), 10(c), 11(a), 12(a), and 13(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum the specified net items to compute total loans and investments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate premises owned and furniture and equipment (Item 15)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the combined total of (1) the actual cost of acquisition of the land and building used as the company's office quarters plus actual cost of benefits applicable to the land or improvements or the unamortized cost of improvements to leased property used as office quarters, and (2) the cost of furniture, fixtures, and equipment (including automobiles) owned by the company. Less: accumulated depreciation—show valuation reserves provided for depreciation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report cost basis for premises and furniture & equipment and list accumulated depreciation separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization costs (Item 16)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the unamortized amount of legal fees, promotional expense, stock certificate costs, incorporation fees and similar costs incurred in organizing the company. (See U.S. Treasury regulations for basis of amortization.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report organization costs net of amortization consistent with Treasury rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other assets and totals (Items 17 and related)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of assets provided for elsewhere, such as portion of miscellaneous notes receivable over one year and similarly recoverable amounts, protection and preservation of investments, prepaid expenses and deferred charges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate noncurrent and miscellaneous assets under this item as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accounts payable and related current liabilities (general guidance around items 20–27)
rubrics_metrics.description: State totals of accounts payable representing 'participations' portions of principal and interest receivable from financed concerns, fees for services rendered, commitment fees for deferred funds, and miscellaneous open account items. Amounts relating to purchase of securities, if significant, shall also be shown parenthetically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose significant purchase-related payables parenthetically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accrued interest payable (Item 21)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of interest accrued on the company's notes, mortgages, and debentures payable; on loans (section 305) and debt securities (section 304) of small business concerns sold with recourse on the company; and on other interest-bearing obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate all accrued interest liabilities in this line.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accrued taxes on income (Item 22)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the total amount of estimated Federal, State, and other income taxes on net income and net realized gain on investments accrued and unpaid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accrue income taxes related to net income and realized gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other accrued expenses (Item 23)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of the company's liability for accrued salaries, accrued taxes on payroll, and other accrued expenses not provided for elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include payroll-related accruals and miscellaneous accrued liabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dividends payable (Item 24)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of the company's liability for dividends declared by the board of directors on capital stock issued and outstanding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report declared but unpaid dividends here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employee taxes withheld (Item 25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the total amount of income and social security taxes withheld from employees' salaries and not yet remitted to the appropriate collectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report payroll tax withholdings awaiting remittance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unapplied receipts and trust receipts (Item 26)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of (1) funds received by the company which have not been applied to loans, debt securities, interest receivable, etc., and (2) funds withheld or received in trust not provided for elsewhere, including earnest money deposits and funds withheld from employees' salaries for the purchase of U.S. Savings Bonds, payment of group life insurance premiums, payment of pension fund contributions, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify unapplied receipts and trust-held funds here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other current and noncurrent liabilities (Items 27 and 33)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the current and noncurrent portions, respectively, of the unpaid principal balance of notes payable other than for funds borrowed, and of liabilities and deferred credits not provided for elsewhere, including that portion of gain on sale of assets which is not realized in cash, demand certificates of deposit, and/or negotiable direct obligations of the U.S. Government. Insert spaces for current and noncurrent portions of amounts owed to directors, officers, and employees, other than salaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Items 27 and 33 to capture miscellaneous and deferred liabilities and noncash-held gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Short-Term Liabilities (Item 28)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the total of items 20 through 27.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum the specified current liability items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notes payable to SBA (section 303) (Item 29)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total unpaid principal balance of notes payable (1) for funds borrowed and received directly from SBA and (2) for funds borrowed from others through guaranteed loans which subsequently have been purchased by SBA. State parenthetically the total amount of investments pledged as collateral for these obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report SBA borrowings and disclose collateral pledged in parentheses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notes payable to others guaranteed by SBA (section 303) (Item 30)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total unpaid principal balance of notes payable for funds borrowed from other than SBA and guaranteed by SBA. State parenthetically the total amount of loans and investments pledged as collateral for these obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish guaranteed borrowings and disclose collateral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notes payable to others not guaranteed by SBA (Item 31)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total unpaid principal balance of notes payable for funds borrowed from other than SBA and not guaranteed by SBA. State parenthetically the total amount of investments pledged as collateral for these obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report non‑SBA guaranteed borrowings and collateral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mortgages payable for funds borrowed (Item 32)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total unpaid principal balance of mortgages payable for funds borrowed on corporate premises or other real estate owned by the company, including purchase money mortgages, conditional sales contracts, etc., given by the company in the acquisition of real property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include all mortgage encumbrances used to finance property acquisition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debentures payable subordinated issued to SBA (section 302) (Item 34)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the unpaid principal balance of funds received by the company under its subordinated debentures payable issued to SBA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report subordinated SBA debentures outstanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Liabilities (Item 35)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the total of the appropriate amounts opposite items 28, 29, 32, 33, and 34.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum specified totals to arrive at total liabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital stock (Item 36)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the total par or stated value of the capital stock of the company issued and not retired.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report issued but outstanding capital stock at par or stated value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paid-in surplus (Item 37)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of surplus arising in excess of par value from (1) sales initially of the company’s capital stock at a price above par, (2) donations to the company of its issued capital stock carried as treasury stock at fair market value or par value, (3) retirements of capital stock purchased at less than par value thereof, (4) sales of treasury stocks in excess of its carrying value on the books, (5) donations or gifts to the company of assets carried not in excess of fair market value, and (6) other capital equity transactions with stockholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail sources of paid‑in surplus as described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treasury stock (Item 38)
rubrics_metrics.description: Less: shares of treasury stock at cost. State the number of shares and the total amount at cost (if purchased) and at fair market value or par value (if donated) of the company's issued capital stock which has been reacquired and has not been retired.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report treasury shares, quantity and valuation (cost or FMV/par if donated).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Stockholders' Paid-In Capital and Paid-In Surplus (Item 39)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the balance resulting from the deduction of item 38 from the appropriate amount opposite item 37.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute net paid-in capital after deducting treasury stock.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital stock subscribed and subscriptions receivable (Item 40)
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the total amount at the subscription price of the company's capital stock subscribed. Less: subscriptions receivable—show the total unpaid balances of capital stock subscriptions receivable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report subscribed capital and deduct unpaid subscriptions to arrive at net subscribed capital.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retained earnings (Item 42)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the accumulated balance of the company's undistributed net income since incorporation, including both net income from operations and net realized gain on investments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include all accumulated retained earnings from operations and realized investment gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriated retained earnings (Item 43)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the total amount of retained earnings earmarked for some future purpose and thus restricted from dividend distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show restricted retained earnings separately as appropriated amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Capital Stock and Surplus (Item 44)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the total of the appropriate amounts opposite items 41 and 43.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum net capital and appropriated retained earnings to get total capital & surplus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total (Balance) — Liabilities plus Capital (Item 45)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the total of items 35 and 44.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure total liabilities plus capital equals total assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memorandum footnote — market or fair value of loans and investments
rubrics_metrics.description: Show in the space provided the market or fair value of loans and investments (shown at cost less allowance for losses in item 14). Securities with market quotations shall be valued at the market bid price provided the securities are registered, or readily registrable, and salable, and further provided that, in the opinion of the board of directors, the bid price could be realized on immediate liquidation. Securities other than those referred to above shall be at cost less allowance for probable losses unless, because of steady progress in the affairs of the portfolio company, an increase above cost to the SBIC is clearly indicated in the SBIC's equity in the book value of the portfolio company's securities as shown on the portfolio company's books; in the latter case securities may be valued at fair value as determined in good faith by the board of directors. The value determined shall be reduced by the amount of what would be an appropriate provision for taxes in respect of the unrealized appreciation included in the determined value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the detailed valuation hierarchy: market-quoted registered/salable securities at bid, others at cost less allowance unless good-faith board-determined fair value justified; reduce for tax provision on unrealized appreciation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify securities valued above cost (schedules)
rubrics_metrics.description: In column (13) of Schedule 1, column (12) of Schedule 2, and column (8) of Schedule 5, identify with an asterisk each security which was valued above cost in arriving at the amount shown as market or fair value of loans and investments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark above-cost valuations with an asterisk in the specified schedule columns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote on contingent liabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Place at the bottom of page 2 of the Financial Report, SBA Form 468, a footnote indicating the total amount of all contingent liabilities of the company. This amount shall be the same as the grand total of Schedule 9 of the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a contingent liabilities footnote matching Schedule 9 total.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Surplus Reconciliations — content and labeling
rubrics_metrics.description: Set forth all activities in accounts for paid-in surplus, retained earnings, and appropriated retained earnings during the fiscal year to date, showing opening balances, additions and deductions, and balances at close of the period. State separately the various additions and deductions, describing clearly the nature of the transactions out of which the items arose. Net income or loss from page 3 should be labeled 'from net income,' and realized gain or loss on investments from page 4 should be labeled 'from net realized gain (or loss) on investments.' With respect to dividends, show for each class of shares the amount per share and in the aggregate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide detailed reconciliation lines, clear descriptions, and explicit labeling as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Income and Expense — income line items (Items 1–13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report separately: 1. Commitment income; 2. Interest on loans; 3. Interest on debt securities; 4. Interest on invested idle funds; 5. Interest income—other; 6. Management consulting service fees; 7. Investigation and service fees charged other lenders; 8. Application and appraisal fees; 9. Dividends on capital stock of SBCs; 10. Sharings in income of SBCs; 11. Income less expense from assets acquired in liquidation of loans and debt securities (show income and expense separate); 12. Other income; 13. Total Income (enter total of appropriate amounts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each income type must be stated separately using the definitions provided; total income is computed from specified items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Income and Expense — financial and operating expense line items (Items 14–41)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report separately: 14. Commitment expense; 15. Interest on obligations payable to SBA; 16. Interest on obligations payable to other than SBA; 17. Stock record and other financial expenses; 18. Total Financial Expenses (sum of 14–17); 19. Advertising and promotional costs; 20. Appraisal and investigation costs; 21. Auditing and examination costs; 22. Communications; 23. Cost of space occupied; 24. Depreciation of corporate premises owned, furniture, and equipment; 25. Directors' and stockholders' meetings costs; 26. Insurance; 27. Investment adviser costs; 28. Legal services; 29. Salaries of officers; 30. Salaries of employees; 31. Taxes, excluding income taxes; 32. Travel; 33. Employee benefits expense; 34. Organization expense; 35. Miscellaneous operating expenses; 36–39. (For unclassified items); 40. Total Operating Expenses (total of items 19–39); 41. Other expenses (nonoperating expenses not provided elsewhere).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each expense category must be filled in as defined and grouped into totals as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Income and Expense — Total Expenses and Net Operating Income (Items 42–49)
rubrics_metrics.description: 42. Total Expenses (enter total of items 18, 40, and 41); 43. Net Operating Income before provision for probable losses and income taxes (item 13 minus 42); 44. Provision for probable losses on receivables; 45. Provision for probable losses on loans, investments, and other assets (list types); 46. Net Operating Income before provision for income taxes (item 43 minus 45); 47. Federal income taxes — net income (fiscal year to date relating to net income exclusive of net realized gain or loss on investments); 48. State and other income taxes — net income; 49. Net Income (Loss) From Operations (item 46 minus item 48).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute totals and provisions in sequence to arrive at net income (loss); present tax provisions separately for federal and state/other.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision for probable losses classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide separate provisions for probable losses on (a) receivables (notes, accounts, accrued interest) and (b) loans, investments, and other assets (including debt securities, capital stock, warrants/options, assets acquired in liquidation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish between receivable loss provisions and loan/investment/asset loss provisions and present them in the specified items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Realized Gain or Loss on Investments — itemization (Items 1–3)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each category (1. U.S. Government securities; 2. Debt securities of SBCs; 3. Capital stock of SBCs) show the aggregate cost, aggregate net proceeds, and net gain or net loss on the sale or other disposition. Use the appropriate form columns as explained in the footnotes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report cost, proceeds, and net gain/loss for each investment category using the specified columns/footnote instructions.
